title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litres Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases — Part 1 Cylinders for Liquefied Petroleum Gases (LPG) — Specification
notes: This standard parameterizes by the steel/material standard used (IS 6240 hot rolled vs IS 15914 high tensile) and by shell construction (two-piece vs three-piece). It has NO size×grade dimension tables; wall thickness is formula-driven and most acceptance criteria are constants. Water-capacity-dependent rules (Cl 14 tolerance, Cl 10.2 foot-ring clearance) are piecewise over a continuous 5–250 l range and are captured as descriptive text rather than a discrete dropdown.

parameters.expected: Certificate of cast (heat) analysis obtained and provided; means established to identify cylinders with the steel casts.
Hot forged from rolled steel bars of Class 1A or Class 2 of IS 1875 or IS 2062; machined bung free from fissures, surface cracks, porosity, laminations, pinholes.

parameters.parameterName: Foot ring / cap / shroud / stay plate material
parameters.expected: Grade 'O' of IS 1079 or IS 2062 or IS 6240, or any other material approved by statutory authority.

parameters.parameterName: Calculated minimum wall thickness from design formulae
parameters.expected: Cylindrical: greater of t=Ph·Do/(200×0.8·J·Re+Ph) and t=0.136·√Do (formula 2 not applicable for IS 15914 steel). Ends: te=Ph·Di/(200×0.8·J·Re+Ph)×K(0.65+0.1K)/4. Ph=25 kg/cm² for LPG vapour pressure ≤16.87 kg/cm² at 15°C.

IS 6240.expected: ≥2.0 mm for water capacity up to and including 13 l; ≥2.4 mm for water capacity above 13 l (Cl 6.2.2), and not less than the greater of the design formulae in Cl 6.2.1.

IS 15914.expected: Per Cl 6.2.3: Do<100 mm → 1.1 mm; 100<Do<150 mm → 1.1+0.008(Do−100) mm; Do>150 mm → (Do/250)+0.7 mm (minimum 1.5 mm). Design formula (2) of Cl 6.2.1 not applicable.

parameters.expected: Agreed finished thickness shall not be less than the minimum calculated wall thickness (Cl 6.2.1 and 6.2.2 or 6.2.3) at any point and any transverse section of the cylindrical portion.
≤1% of nominal diameter of cylinder, subject to a maximum of 2 mm.

Two-piece.expected: Difference between maximum and minimum outside diameter in same cross-section ≤ 1% of the mean of these diameters (measured adjacent to, not over, welds).

Three-piece.expected: Difference between maximum and minimum outside diameter in same cross-section ≤ 1.5% of the mean of these diameters (measured adjacent to, not over, welds).

parameters.expected: Internal and external surfaces free from defects which will adversely affect safe working of the cylinder.
Contour of dished end deviates from approved dimensions by ≤1.25% of nominal diameter (radial) and ≤1% (axial); deviations not abrupt and outside the specified shape.
Maximum deviation of shell from a straight line ≤0.3% of the cylindrical length.
Deviation from vertical ≤10 mm per metre length.
Surfaces of plates at seams not out of alignment by more than 10% of the plate thickness.

parameters.parameterName: End cylindrical skirt / parallel portion length
parameters.expected: Minimum length 20 mm or three times the shell thickness, whichever is greater (semi-ellipsoidal end).

Full penetration; smooth fusion; no cracks, notching, porous patches, undercutting or abrupt irregularity; welded bead not concave. Joggled butt welds verified by macro etch, bend and tensile testing.

Technique and acceptability per IS 1182/IS 2595/IS 3657/IS 4853 and 8.7 of IS 2825; sensitive to a defect of thickness equal to 2% of combined thickness of weld and strip. Spot radiography: 1 in every 50 consecutive cylinders (Cl 13.2.1).

parameters.parameterName: Eccentricity of protective metal ring / grill
parameters.expected: Eccentricity of welded/fixed metal ring or grill w.r.t. valve pad/bung ≤1% of nominal diameter, subject to a maximum of 3 mm (as amended by Amendment No. 2).
Water-filled container (half nominal water capacity) dropped from 1.2 m so the protective device strikes a hard flat surface — no damage to the valve. (De-pressurized cylinders only.)
Handle/lifting arrangement withstands static loading in any direction equal to twice the weight of the cylinder when filled with water.

parameters.parameterName: Foot ring ground clearance (bottom below cylinder shell)
parameters.specText: Minimum clearance varies with nominal water capacity: ≤34 l → ≥8 mm; >34 l and ≤50 l → ≥15 mm; >50 l → ≥25 mm. Foot ring ≥20 mm from circumferential weld; sheet thickness ≥ calculated wall thickness.

parameters.expected: Bung clean, even, required machining finish; threads smooth, not broken; conform to taper thread gauges of IS 7202 / IS 9122 / IS 15894. 3% of machined bungs inspected; one bung sectioned for thread form and finish.

parameters.parameterName: Heat treatment of cylinder (by steel standard)

IS 6240.expected: Efficiently and uniformly normalized OR stress relieved after all welding and before hydrostatic test (Cl 11.1). No localized heat treatment (Cl 11.3). Mark 'N' or 'SR' accordingly.

IS 15914.expected: Normalizing is COMPULSORY per the material standard (Cl 11.2) in addition to the requirements of Cl 11.1. No localized heat treatment (Cl 11.3). Mark 'N'.

parameters.specText: Tolerance for water capacity: up to and including 13 l → +5/0 percent; above 13 l → +3/0 percent or 0.65 l, whichever is more. Checked by weighing method.

parameters.expected: Pressure raised gradually to test pressure and retained ≥30 s after drying; no pressure reduction, no leakage, no visible bulge or deformation. Failure → reject.
25 kg/cm² (≈2.45 MPa) for LPG with vapour pressure ≤16.87 kg/cm² (gauge) at 15°C. For vapour pressure >16.87 kg/cm² take value from IS 8867 and approved by statutory authority.
Each cylinder (dried, fitted with valve) subjected to air pressure ≥1.180 MPa (12 kgf/cm²) for 1 min while immersed in water — no leakage from body or valve pad joint. Dry air with safety cap fitted.

Three representative cylinders cycled without failure to either: (a) upper cyclic pressure = 2/3 of test pressure for 80 000 cycles, or (b) = test pressure for 12 000 cycles. Lower cyclic pressure ≤10% of upper; frequency ≤0.25 Hz (15 cycles/min); outside surface temperature ≤50°C. After test the cylinders are burst tested to 17.2.
Measured bursting pressure Pb ≥225% of the test pressure Ph under all circumstances.

(a) Burst without fragmentation; (b) fracture not parallel to circumferential weld within 10 mm of its edge; (c) main fracture not brittle — edges at angle to diametrical plane with reduction of area through thickness; (d) no visible defect in the metal.

parameters.parameterName: Volumetric expansion ratio at burst, Min
parameters.expected: Ratio of volumetric expansion to initial volume ≥20% if cylinder length > diameter; ≥17% if length ≤ diameter.

parameters.parameterName: Yield strength of finished cylinder, Min
parameters.specText: Determined yield strength (wherever applicable) shall not be less than the respective requirement for the steel specified in Clause 4 (IS 6240 / IS 15914 / 4.1.1 guaranteed value). Method per IS 3196 (Part 3).

parameters.parameterName: Tensile strength of finished cylinder, Min
parameters.specText: Determined tensile strength shall not be less than the respective requirement for the steel specified in Clause 4 (IS 6240 / IS 15914). Method per IS 3196 (Part 3).
Determined percentage elongation shall not be less than the respective requirement for the steel specified in Clause 4 (IS 6240 / IS 15914). Method per IS 3196 (Part 3).

parameters.expected: Bend test specimen having cracks or other open defects exceeding 3 mm, measured in any direction on the convex surface, is treated as a failure.

parameters.parameterName: Cylinder body integrity impact test (by steel standard)

IS 6240.expected: Not required (additional impact test applies only to cylinders manufactured from IS 15914 steel).

IS 15914.expected: Required as type test per Annex C-1: Flat surface impact F=30M (striking velocity 7–8 m/s) and Edge impact F=12M (4–5 m/s), M = max operating mass in kg. Pressurized cylinders shall not leak; cylinders subjected to burst meet 17.2 and to fatigue meet 17.1. Damage assessed per IS 16054.

IS 6240.expected: Not required (drop test under Annex C applies only to cylinders manufactured from IS 15914 steel).

IS 15914.expected: Required as type test per Annex C-2: two finished cylinders (with foot-ring/valve protection) at max operating mass, pressurized to Pf/1.2, dropped from 1.2 m onto a 10 mm steel plate, twice in each of five orientations (10 drops each). Cylinders shall not leak; burst cylinders meet 17.2; fatigue cylinders meet 17.1.

parameters.expected: Permanently stamped: serial number/manufacturer monogram/owner ID; this IS number; max working pressure (MPa); test pressure (MPa) and date of hydrostatic test; agreed finished thickness (mm); tare/gross weight (kg) and water capacity (l); inspecting agency mark; 'N' or 'SR'; name of gas. Tare weight includes valve.
Painted externally signal red colour (Shade No. 537 of IS 5) or any other colour approved by statutory authority.
Minimum 37 microns unless otherwise agreed (zinc wire per IS 12447, spraying per IS 6586). Surface grit-blasted to SA 2.5.
Both layers of primer and paint total thickness minimum 30 microns (synthetic enamel IS 2932 or polyurethane IS 13213, signal red).
Alternate to zinc+primer+enamel: powder coating per IS 13871, signal red, minimum 50 microns (per Amendment No. 4).
